comment: Best-per-scenario picks. Evidence-researched 2026-09-18 (Artificial Analysis, lab cards, community adoption); freedom of license used as tiebreaker. Rendered as the 'Find your local AI' section of the catalog.

picks.label: Phone / edge (any device)
picks.why: 2.5B that beats 4B-class models (avg 53.9 vs 51.1); official phone builds; Apache-2.0

picks.label: Ordinary 8GB laptop
picks.why: Most-downloaded model on all of HF (9.2M/mo); ~5GB quantized; multimodal; Apache-2.0

picks.label: 16–32GB RAM / small GPU
picks.why: Flagship-adjacent coding (SWE-bench 73.4) at 3B-active speed; needs ~21GB quantized

picks.label: Gaming PC, 24–32GB VRAM
picks.why: MIT; strongest 30B-class for agents/tool use; Qwen3.8-27B the dense raw-intelligence rival

picks.label: Workstation, 64–128GB
picks.why: Frontier-company benchmarks (GPQA 86.6) fitting 96–128GB unified memory; Apache-2.0

picks.label: Mac Studio / 256GB+
picks.why: MIT 320B MoE (18B active), 41.9% AA index — best capability-per-byte in class

picks.label: Server / multi-GPU
picks.why: #1 open-weight model on the Artificial Analysis index (53.2%); MIT

picks.label: Coding assistant
picks.why: The Sept-2026 local default: 61.7 SWE-bench Pro, 4-bit quant matches full model, fits 24GB

picks.label: Vision / screenshots
picks.why: Natively multimodal — same download as the coding pick; MiniCPM-V-4 for 8GB machines

picks.label: OCR / document reading
picks.why: 1.3B, MIT, 94.6% OmniDocBench — beats frontier closed models and runs on a CPU

picks.label: Math & reasoning
picks.why: Only frontier-adjacent reasoner that fits 24GB; DeepSeek-Math-V2 for max accuracy (server)

picks.label: Long documents (1M tokens)
picks.why: Verified 1,048,576-token window from config.json; MIT; Qwen3.8-27B caps at 262K

picks.label: Translation
picks.why: Purpose-built 2B translator from the WMT-winning Hunyuan-MT line; Apache-2.0; CPU-friendly

picks.label: Speech-to-text
picks.why: Top-20 ASR on all of HF by adoption (2.5M/mo); Apache-2.0; 2.3B

picks.label: Text-to-speech
picks.why: Most-adopted Chinese open TTS (2.6M/mo), voice cloning, Apache-2.0; VoxCPM2 runs on CPU

picks.label: Image generation
picks.why: Only top-tier open image family at a permissive license and consumer VRAM (~16GB FP8)
